$comment: Language models the app can run in the browser. scripts/download-model.mjs downloads them into public/models and copies these settings into public/models/manifest.json, which src/llm/worker.ts reads. 'small' is for phones and tablets and is the fallback everywhere; 'large' is for computers with WebGPU. chatTemplate: variables for the chat template (thinking stays off for option picking). thinking: reason before free-form answers, hidden from the user, at most thinkingBudget tokens (off for 'large': at the ~6 tokens/s a browser gets, 512 reasoning tokens delayed every answer by over a minute). generation: overrides of src/llm/config.ts GENERATION for free-form answers.
